{{Top}}
An '''engineering droid''' was one of the five major subgroups of [[Class two droid/Legends|class two droid]], along with [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]], [[environmental droid]]s, [[Explorer droid/Legends|exploration droids]], and [[Maintenance droid/Legends|sophisticated repair droids]]. They differed from their [[Class one droid/Legends|first-degree counterparts]], the [[biological science droid]]s and [[physical science droid]]s, in that engineering droids worked in applied sciences, using their knowledge to solve real-world engineering and technical problems. Engineering droids worked in a variety of applied sciences, but performed poorly if forced to undertake a different job than the one they were programmed for.
